scientific_integrity: Exact analytic proof and symbolic identities supplied; numerical integrations are illustrative; no independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to the symmetric equal-feedback reduction with positive payoff gaps and interior initial data; in the outward regime the theorem does not identify a unique limiting boundary orbit. Numerical checks supplement but do not replace the analytic proof; equivalent prior treatments outside inspected literature remain a risk.
title: Global dissipation and neutral foliation in a two-environment evolutionary game
